title: Baked Fish en Papillote with Mediterranean Crust
description: Moist and flavorful fish baked in parchment paper with a crunchy Mediterranean crust. Perfect for a light and healthy dinner.

ingredients.name: Fish fillet
ingredients.notes: white fish such as cod or tilapia

instructions: Season the fish fillet with salt and pepper.
In a bowl, mix together the Mediterranean croute and a pinch of salt.
Place a piece of parchment paper on a baking sheet.
Place the fish fillet in the center of the parchment paper.
Sprinkle the Mediterranean croute mixture evenly over the fish.
Drizzle the honeyed oil over the croute.
Fold the parchment paper to create a packet, sealing the edges.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
